7505.title: Usage account artwork receives a resource key instead of a provider key
7505.rootCauseOneLine: The account row forwards its resource id into ProviderIcon, which matches frontend icon registrations by provider id.

prReviews.verdict: Static root-cause alignment; PR branch not executed

7505.proposedFix: Adapt the account icon input to the provider identity while preserving the resource identity for usage bookkeeping. Existing open PR #7506 targets this boundary; no duplicate fix was opened.
7505.caveats: Source-level SDK-boundary failure repeated in two clean trusted checkouts by the same agent. Desktop artwork and the reporter's third-party provider installation were not exercised. The complete reproduction test is inline in the HTML report; raw artifacts remain local.
